title: Port Jacobian Move Pieces From Go To Rust
description: Port Jacobian Move Pieces From Go To Rust
summary: Ported Jacobian-based move_pieces_in_design from Go to Rust. Added plane_to_matrix4, connection_placement_translation_basis, child_connector_origin_world, connection_with_numeric_delta, solve_connection_origin_min_norm, connection_diff_translation_fallback, and connection_diff_from_structural_move_vector helper functions. Updated move_pieces_in_design to accept Kit reference and resolve types/connectors for Jacobian computation. Updated move test to load metabolism kit and handle optional connection diff fields. All 63 Rust lib tests pass.
